milestone: DSH2 M2 - Paraphrase synthesis and ambiguity control
implementation: generate_frame_paraphrases / generate_answer_family_paraphrases / FrameLeakDetectorV1 / enforce_grounding_floor / dedupe_paraphrase_rows / FrameParaphraseFixtureProviderV1
depends_on: dsl.semantic_frame (SLM-363, SemanticFrameV1/CAP1SchemaV1) + dsl.paraphrase_provenance (SLM-364, provider protocol + validate_raw_response/redact_text)

provider.network: none (fully offline deterministic fixture, no credentials)

leak_detector.dsl_production_forms: component names from the canonical answer's production forms (e.g. Stack(, Card(, TextContent() plus their exact-case bare tokens
leak_detector.marker_surfaces: :ident / $ident codec forms, including the answer's exact placeholder values
leak_detector.provenance_fields: ast_path, schema_field, canonical_source, schema_fingerprint, frame_fingerprint, prompt_digest, response_digest, cache_key, category

grounding_floor: accept only prompts covering every required fact phrase, stating no forbidden fact phrase, and passing the declared leak detector; a style that cannot meet the floor is dropped with a recorded reason (stop rule) rather than published noisy

dedup.repeated_style_template: same-style template signature (style + sorted coverage keys)
dedup.scope: within one frame's set and across answer families (generate_answer_family_paraphrases)
dedup.rejected_rows: always counted with reasons; never silently dropped

linking: every accepted row links the canonical answer via sha256(canonical_source) fingerprint plus the accepted equivalence-set fingerprints; answer text never appears in prompts

claim_limits: No real LLM API was called: no network access, no credentials, no cost; all generation used the offline deterministic fixture provider.
Fixture/contract-level evidence only: two small openui fixture frames (Card/TextContent, Callout), not a corpus build.

Lexical diversity between styles is bounded by design: every style must cover the same required fact phrases verbatim, so token-multiset Jaccard between styles is necessarily high (0.78-0.88 on the card fixture); diversity comes from template connective prose and structure, and is reported honestly rather than inflated by weakening grounding.

The declared marker detector also matches :ident/$ident-shaped tokens in free natural-language content literals (e.g. a literal '3:4'-style token with a letter after the colon); no such literal exists in the fixtures, and prompts are built from frame facts only, so this is a documented detector characteristic, not an observed failure.
No corpus synthesis, train, model eval, benchmark, checkpoint, AgentEvals publication, capability certificate, or ship claim was produced.
